newsitem.title: USA: International files for up to 3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: International files for up to 3 mln shares.

text.p: International Remote Imaging Systems Inc said Monday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to three million common shares.

In a filing, the company said underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option for up to 450,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Jefferies & Co Inc, Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc and M. Kane & Co Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to repay $1.19 million of outstanding indebtedness incurred to finance the acquisition of Perceptive Scientific Instruments Inc, to repurchase shares of the company's common stock and warrants to buy common stock, the company said.
Proceeds will also be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
International Remote said there will be 8,908,392 shares outstanding after the offering.
